B.LEAGUE Standings

Source: R/bleague.R
bleague_standings.Rd

Standings of one B.LEAGUE season and division, one row per club per table (conference, division or wild card).

Endpoint: GET https://www.bleague.jp/standings/

One row per club per table. section is the table heading in Japanese (East, Central and West divisions, wild card; B2 and B3 may have one table with a different heading) and section_en its English name for those four. A club can appear in a division table and in the wild-card table. win_pct is a 0-1 fraction. The page shows the standings as of the request, not a season end.

Usage

bleague_standings(season, tab)

Arguments

season

(integer required): season END year (2026 = 2025-26); the site's own year is the START year, so the request sends season - 1.

tab

(integer required): division tab: 1 = B1, 2 = B2, 3 = B3.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble with these columns:

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26), the feed's Year (the START year) plus one.
tabintegerDivision tab: 1 = B1, 2 = B2, 3 = B3.
season_labelcharacterSeason label of the selected option (2025-26).
sectioncharacterTable heading in Japanese (East, Central and West divisions, wild card); section_en is its English name.
section_encharacterEnglish name of section for the four known headings; null for any other heading.
rankintegerRank in that table; a club in a division table also appears in the wild-card table.
team_idcharacterB.LEAGUE TeamID as text (key space: B.LEAGUE clubs, stable across seasons AND club renames: 703 = Tochigi Brex in 2016-17 = Utsunomiya Brex in 2025-26). The feed sends a string on v2 and an integer on v1; both are text here. Not a player id.
teamcharacterClub name in Japanese as the standings page prints it (e.g. Chiba Jets).
team_shortcharacterClub short name in Japanese (e.g. Chiba J).
winsintegerGames won so far this season in the table.
lossesintegerGames lost so far this season in the table.
win_pctdoubleWin percentage as a 0-1 fraction.
games_behinddoubleGames behind the table leader.
points_forintegerPoints scored over the season to date.
points_againstintegerPoints allowed over the season to date.
point_diffintegerPoint differential.
home_recordcharacterHome record W-L.
away_recordcharacterAway record W-L.
last_nintegerLength of the recent-form window the page shows: 5 or 10 games.
last_n_recordcharacterRecord W-L over the last_n games.
streakcharacterCurrent streak as printed: W5 = five straight wins, L1 = one loss.
division_titlecharacterDivision-title mark as printed; null when none ('–').

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in bleague_game_info().

See also

Other B.LEAGUE Functions: bleague_game_info(), bleague_leaders(), bleague_pbp(), bleague_period_scores(), bleague_player_box(), bleague_schedule(), bleague_schedule_clubs(), bleague_schedule_days(), bleague_schedule_events(), bleague_score_track(), bleague_shots(), bleague_team_box(), bleague_team_summary()
